starter.quality_note: Latency-first bootstrap model for proving private local inference and orchestration on Render Free. Limited reasoning depth.

standard.label: Aerynza Core 0.5B
standard.quality_note: Stronger instruction-following profile for a 2 GB service.

pro.label: Aerynza v6b 1.7B LoRA
pro.quality_note: Qwen3-1.7B base with v6b per-capability/execution LoRA. 100% per-cap, 99.84% execution probe, 5/6 canonical 7/8 receipt. Test only; production replacement not yet approved.

pro_proven.label: Aerynza proven 1.7B LoRA
pro_proven.quality_note: Qwen3-1.7B base with proven_parent LoRA. 100% generic canonical and receipt gates, 83% per-cap. Use for safety-first testing.

pro_v16.label: Aerynza v16 1.7B merged
pro_v16.quality_note: Qwen3-1.7B full-model merge 70% proven_parent + 30% v6b. Converted to Q8_0 GGUF. Test/evaluate before promotion.

pro_v19.label: Aerynza v19 1.7B merged
pro_v19.quality_note: Qwen3-1.7B full-model merge of v17 support + v18 creative adapters. 640-capability API evaluator: 637/640 passed (99.53%). 3 'failures' are correct receipt-discipline refusals (post_workout, email_intelligence, writing_email). Converted to Q8_0 GGUF. Candidate ready; human review before replacement.

pro_v231.label: Aerynza AI v231 Production
pro_v231.quality_note: Qwen3-1.7B v231-B merged release. Raw model gates: 628/640 capability execution, 6/6 canonical, 8/8 integrated receipt truth, and 19/20 replacement quality. Five raw capability misses were semantic false negatives; seven genuine misses and emergency escalation are covered by tested deterministic runtime guards. Approved as a reversible production profile.

pro_base.label: Aerynza Live 1.7B
pro_base.quality_note: Primary latency-bounded profile for multilingual conversation, planning, structured cognition, and tool selection on the 4 GB Pro service.

candidate.label: Aerynza AI
candidate.quality_note: Controlled benchmark profile for evaluating stronger natural conversation and instruction following without the long hidden-reasoning latency of the 4B Qwen3 worker.

deep.label: Aerynza Deep 4B
deep.quality_note: Memory-bounded deeper-reasoning worker for queued research, synthesis, evaluation, and apprenticeship distillation where interactive latency is not required.
